crossRefs.note: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.
Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.
“If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
